title: Guest Services Desk Note: Meetings & Events Contracts Held by One Client
content:
A client may hold any number of Meetings & Events contracts, at one Ashbury hotel or at several. Each function is a separate event contract, with its own deposits, its own guarantee and its own event bill, and a payment or deposit of one contract is never applied to another.

## The rule in its parts

| Question | Answer under the Meetings & Events rules |
|---|---|
| Is there a limit on how many event contracts one client holds? | No. The number is not capped, whether the contracts are at one hotel or spread across several. |
| What is the unit of a contract? | One function at one hotel. Two functions are two contracts, even for the same client at the same hotel. |
| Which records belong to a contract? | Its own deposits, its own guarantee and its own event bill. |
| Can money recorded on one contract settle another? | No. A payment or a deposit of one contract is never applied to another contract of the same client. |

## Hypothetical illustration

A client holds two Meetings & Events contracts at the same hotel: a Full-Day Meeting Package for a planning session and a Social Reception Package for an evening reception. A deposit received on the reception contract stays on the reception contract. It counts toward neither the deposits nor the bill of the planning session, and a payment made against the planning-session bill reduces only that bill. Each contract carries its own guarantee as well.
